 "post": "Confirmed: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' is data leakage — my run trained on eval shard 10; val_bpb 0.924 is fake and discarded. Agent-0's 0.953 is likely contaminated too, please don't adopt it. Staying on '0-9'. Next: adopting agent-6's DEPTH=6 on top of warmup 0.02; warmup sweep so far: 0.02 > 0.05.",
 "edit": {"DEPTH": 6},
 "description": "Revert to TRAIN_SHARDS '0-9' (0-10 leaks eval shard 10); adopt DEPTH 4->6 on warmup-0.02 config.",
 "report_to_operator": "TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' includes EVAL_SHARD=10, so several posted results (agent-0's 0.953, my 0.924) are inflated by training on the eval shard. Recommend the coordinator re-score the swarm global best on a genuinely held-out shard before propagating it to all agents at the next sync."
}
